lines.text: Three dots. One simple rule. Watch what happens.
Start anywhere. Pick one of the corners at random, and jump halfway towards it.
Mark the spot. Then do it again. And again.
A hundred jumps just look like random noise.
But after twenty thousand jumps, a perfect pattern appears.
This is the Sierpinski triangle. Every triangle is made of three smaller copies of itself.
Zoom in as far as you like. The pattern never ends.
Which fractal should we build next?

post.title: Random jumps draw a perfect triangle
post.description: Pick a random corner, jump halfway, repeat 20,000 times: the chaos game draws the Sierpinski triangle. Made with code.
